bagPolicy.summary: Nationwide Arena enforces a no bag policy, allowing only specific exceptions. All bags are subject to x-ray screening.
bagPolicy.note: Medical bags and diaper bags are exceptions to the no bag policy.

parking.note: There are over 15,000 parking spaces within a 10-minute walk of Nationwide Arena, with prices varying by location. Parking can be purchased in advance or on the event day. Accessible parking is available but may be limited during heavily attended events.

rideshare.note: ALL pick-ups and drop-offs take place on West Street. Vehicles MUST be attended at all times.

concessions.note: The Nationwide Arena offers a variety of food and drink options, with alcohol sales strictly regulated according to Ohio law. Delaware North Sportservice is the primary vendor, ensuring compliance with ID checks for alcoholic beverages.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: Accessible seating is available on all levels of the arena at all price levels.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Nationwide Arena's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Current official guidance does not publish one universal will-call schedule for every event at Nationwide Arena. Use the delivery instructions in the official ticket order and confirm event-day box-office details before traveling to the venue.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Nationwide Arena. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
